carl_sales: Quick askProspect (merchant platform) wants two procurement options: vendor-managed HSM or customer-supplied appliance. RFP wants attestation, private peering, and a rotation SLA (2h monthly). Need SOW bullets + pricing delta by EOD.
mina_se: Paste the exact RFP bullets? will triage network/latency constraints.
carl_sales: They wrote: 
- BYO HSM (PKCS#11) or vendor-managed HSM
- Key import via wrapped blobs or on-site ceremony
- Rotation window 02:00-04:00 UTC, availability >99.9% outside window
- Attestation artifacts (vendor-signed PEM + firmware hashes + serials)
- Escrow export option with chain-of-custody
- Private peering only for KMS RPCs
raj_crypto: We support both modes. For BYO we deploy a connector in their VPC; wrapped blobs are unwrapped only in the HSM boundary. Control plane sees metadata only.
anya_ops: Rotation plan: stage, atomic pointer-swap, keep previous key for 24h TTL for rollback, then GC. This prevents KV cache flushes and avoids latency spikes. 2h window ok if we avoid full restarts.
kate_finance: Pricing model we usually show: managed-HSM monthly + per-crypto-op premium + SOW day-rate for ceremonies/escrow + possible egress if physical transfer required. I'll draft numbers once connector count is confirmed (recommend 2 for HA at ~250 qps).
legal-bot: Automated: please attach security QA snippet for key handling (template link).
mina_se: I'll produce the one-paragraph security statement and a sample import command + ASCII network sketch to convert to PNG.
carl_sales: Great. Please deliver SOW bullets, delta table, attestation sample link, and the PNG by EOD. Procurement deadline Monday. :pray:
